items.title: 52150_Charlie Barnet oral history interview
items.q: Snader Telescription in which the title number is played by Charlie Barnet and His Orchestra, including ... Dave Wells, trombone

ctx.x: Okay. And then, "Cherokee," 1951, three minutes. Snader Telescription in which the title number is played by Charlie Barnet and His Orchestra, including Claude Williamson, piano, Bill Holman, tenor sax, Dave Wells, trombone, and Bob Daws, baritone sax.
